2607.27083.title: Scores Are Not Decisions: Cost-Aware Stopping for Tool Acquisition in LLM Agents
2607.27083.paper_summary: As LLM agents increasingly depend on diverse external services such as search engines, databases, and connectors, agent harnesses face a fundamental tool-selection challenge: acquiring too few tools leaves the task under-informed, while too many adds cost, context load, and privacy exposure. Routers and retrievers can rank candidate tools by relevance, but a ranking alone does not determine how many are worth selecting. Existing approaches leave acquisition under heterogeneous costs unaddressed. We formulate this decision as cost-aware marginal decision-focused stopping (CAM-DF) over ranked tool prefixes, with CAM-DF-lite as a compact interpretable variant. We train directly on the offline gap between stopping now and the best continuation: its sign labels the decision, its magnitude weights each error by the payoff at stake. We prove this objective is Bayes-aligned with the stopping target and that score-only rules are suboptimal under heterogeneous costs. We evaluate on 1,343 tasks across five tool-use domains. On $τ$-bench Retail, CAM-DF attains the highest payoff among deployable methods, with gains over a predict-then-threshold baseline across all five ranking sources and two cost regimes. Our approach is state-of-the-art under heterogeneous costs and high cost pressure, with larger gains under weaker rankings. In live execution, CAM-DF exposes the agent to 37\% fewer tools than full access while maintaining comparable task success. The CAM-DF family is a lightweight pre-execution plugin that turns existing tool rankings into lower-cost acquisition decisions without fine-tuning the underlying LLM.
2607.27083.paper_summary_zh: 隨著大型語言模型（LLM）代理越來越依賴於各種外部服務，如搜索引擎、數據庫和連接器，代理的工具選擇面臨一個基本挑戰：獲取的工具過少會使任務信息不足，而工具過多則會增加成本、上下文負擔和隱私暴露。路由器和檢索器可以根據相關性對候選工具進行排序，但僅僅依賴排序並不能確定值得選擇多少工具。現有的方法未能解決在異質成本下的獲取問題。我們將這一決策公式化為基於成本的邊際決策聚焦停止（CAM-DF），並提出了CAM-DF-lite作為一種緊湊的可解釋變體。我們直接對比停止當前和最佳繼續之間的離線差距進行訓練：其符號標記決策，其大小根據風險權重每個錯誤。我們證明這一目標與停止目標是貝葉斯對齊的，並且在異質成本下僅基於分數的規則是次優的。我們在五個工具使用領域的1,343個任務上進行評估。在$τ$-bench零售上，CAM-DF在可部署方法中獲得了最高的收益，並在所有五個排名來源和兩個成本範疇中超過了預測後閾值的基線。我們的方法在異質成本和高成本壓力下是最先進的，在較弱的排名下獲得了更大的收益。在實時執行中，CAM-DF使代理接觸的工具比完全訪問少37\%，同時保持可比的任務成功率。CAM-DF家族是一個輕量級的預執行插件，將現有的工具排名轉化為更低成本的獲取決策，而無需微調底層的LLM。
